title: fix(plugin-detail,types): seed new record pages with the `default` template and type the page `template` by reference to the spec
body:
Part of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23610

Clause-②: no

**This PR lands before objectstack-ai/objectstack#23708.** That PR closes `PageSchema.template` in `@objectstack/spec` to four layout names: `default`, `header-sidebar-main`, `three-column` and `dashboard`. It retires `full-width` by name, with `default` as the replacement. objectstack's AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist, step 4) says a removal that breaks the pinned sibling checkout "ships together with the sibling fix and the pin bump — or it does not ship". This PR is that sibling fix. After it merges, #23708 moves `.objectui-sha` through `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` to a commit that carries it, and lands.

## What changes

- **Studio's new record page is seeded with `default`.** `buildDefaultPageSchema` wrote `template: 'full-width'`, which #23708 refuses at save, so the first save of a new record page would fail with a 422. The renderer's `TEMPLATE_REGISTRY` maps `default` and `full-width` to the same `FullWidthTemplate`, so a seeded page lays out exactly as before.
- **`PageNodeSchema.template` is typed by reference to the spec: `SpecPage['template']`.** The member was re-declared as `string` over the inherited spec member. Against #23708's spec that widening is TS2430 on the interface.
- **The zod mirror's `template` is the spec's member too** (`stripImportedDefaults(SpecPageSchema).shape.template`). `z.string()` accepted every name, so against #23708's spec the zod face would have been wider than the TS face, and the zod-mirror parity test reports exactly that. Against today's `@objectstack/spec` (`^18.0.0-next.1`, where the member is a string) both faces accept what they accepted before.
- **The renderer still recognises `full-width`.** It is not changed: pages already stored with `full-width` keep rendering.
- Two tests re-pinned to `default`. One changeset, `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/types`.

## Verification (the dev's report, posted on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23610)

- Against today's spec: type-check of `types`, `plugin-detail` and `app-shell` passes (32/32). Tests: `types` with `plugin-detail` 655 files, `app-shell` 1410 files, and `types` again after the zod edit 383 files, all green.
- Against objectstack-ai/objectstack#23708's spec, built and linked into `packages/types`:
  - `tsc` on the three tsconfigs exits 0.
  - Reverting the TS member to `string` reproduces TS2430.
  - Assigning `'full-width'` gives TS2322 naming the four layouts.
  - At runtime the zod face refuses `full-width` and accepts `default`; under today's spec it is unchanged.
- Local gates: changeset presence, no-major, cross-file line citations and control bytes all exit 0.
- On `main`, the only page-template writers of `'full-width'` are the seed and the two tests changed here, plus the renderer registry, which reads it. No page writes `isDefault: true` outside a record page.
